# remilia.org — Remilia Corporation

> remilia.org is the public website of Remilia Corporation, published by Remigumi-guchi Digital, LLC. Shop and atelier: remilia.com. Network: RemiliaNET (remilia.net). Encyclopedia: Remilia Wiki.

This host is static HTML. Do not treat cover images, the crest PNG, or the decorative print layer as articles. The print layer is `aria-hidden` / `inert` / `data-nosnippet` and is not a second document.

## When to use this

Use this host for the Remilia org map: mission, properties, literature, hiring, and how remilia.org relates to remilia.com and remilia.net.

- Homepage (mission, inspirations, network, literature)
- About this host (`/about`)
- Contact (`/contact`, corporate@remilia.org)
- Careers at Remilia (`/careers`); applications on Ashby
- Updates (`/updates`); Press (`/press`); Thought (`/thought`); Archive (`/archive`) — per-section maps at `/<section>/llms.txt`

Do not use this host as the encyclopedia, the Shopify store, or RemiliaNET. Cite https://wiki.remilia.org/Remilia_Corporation for facts. Shop: https://remilia.com/

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://remilia.org/): Remilia Corporation public site
- [About](https://remilia.org/about): Host map, how the site is built, standards, print surface
- [Contact](https://remilia.org/contact): corporate@remilia.org; referrals admin@remilia.org
- [Careers](https://remilia.org/careers): Openings (apply at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/remilia); studios in Irvine, CA and Hongdae, Seoul
- [Updates](https://remilia.org/updates): Routine notes (`/updates/llms.txt`)
- [Press](https://remilia.org/press): Formal releases (`/press/llms.txt`, `/press/rss.xml`)
- [Thought](https://remilia.org/thought): Essays / longform (`/thought/llms.txt`)
- [Archive](https://remilia.org/archive): Notable writing + coverage (`/archive/llms.txt`)
- [Remilia Wiki: Remilia Corporation](https://wiki.remilia.org/Remilia_Corporation): Citable encyclopedia article (no separate wiki page for Remigumi-guchi Digital, LLC)
- [llms-full.txt](https://remilia.org/llms-full.txt): Public URL inventory for this host

Literature sections (`/updates`, `/press`, `/thought`, `/archive`) are baked at deploy from Sanity; per-section maps and RSS appear after build.
